faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (Adresse traegt eine session_id, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: While arrogant suitors overrun his home, Telemachus seeks a path to find his lost father.
kurzfassung: Ten years after the Trojan War, the gods gather on Olympus to plan the homecoming of Ulysses, who is trapped on a remote island by the goddess Calypso. Meanwhile, Minerva visits Ulysses' home in Ithaca disguised as a visitor to give his son Telemachus the courage to confront his mother's unruly suitors and search for news of his father. Inspired by the visit, Telemachus publicly challenges the suitors and prepares for a sea voyage in quest of his missing father.
stichpunkte: Jupiter notes that mortals bring suffering upon themselves, citing Aegisthus as an example.
Minerva pleads with Jupiter on behalf of Ulysses, who is detained by Calypso.
Jupiter explains that Neptune remains furious with Ulysses for blinding his son Polyphemus.
Minerva travels to Ithaca disguised as Mentes to inspire Telemachus.
Telemachus hospitably welcomes the disguised goddess while rowdy suitors consume his estate.
Minerva advises Telemachus to call an assembly, expel the suitors, and sail to Pylos and Sparta for news.
Penelope grieves for Ulysses, but Telemachus asserts his authority as master of the household.
Telemachus boldly tells the suitors he will summon them to an assembly to demand their departure.

clips.hook: A trapped hero and a distant god
clips.text: Atlas's daughter detains the stranded hero on a remote island and uses every charm to make him forget his homeland. Despite these desperate circumstances, the supreme deity ignores his plight.

clips.hook: The bitter cost of a bard's song
clips.text: Performances celebrating past glories provide little comfort when funded by the estate of a man whose bones are rotting in the wilderness. The young host laments that even rumors of his father's return are no longer believed.

clips.hook: Princes consume an estate under the guise of courtship
clips.text: Noblemen from neighboring islands flock to the home under the pretext of seeking the queen's hand in marriage, while actively devouring the household's wealth and leaving nothing behind.

clips.hook: A son steps up and silences grief
clips.text: The young heir asserts that bards are not responsible for the tragedies they sing about, as divine forces dictate human fortunes. He instructs his mother to return to her private quarters and daily tasks while he manages the household.

clips.hook: A loyal servant's value in ancient times
clips.text: A trusted housekeeper was purchased long ago for a substantial price and treated with immense respect within the family due to her devoted care during the master's infancy.

beschreibung:
After ten years of war, Ulysses sets out on his journey home — but the sea shows no mercy, and the gods have plans of their own. The Odyssey is a tale of wonders, temptations, and dangers, and of a man who relies on his wit and courage to defy fate.

Filled with adventure, emotion, and vivid imagery — this is one of those stories that has captivated readers for thousands of years.
